seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Mirror-blocks/marker game: block mode A1/A2 move both blocks y-/+4, A3/A4 move block_left -/+4 and block_right +/-4 in x; each block moves alone into a free cell (bounds [2,58], invisible maze {(14,38),(6,18),(38,14),(22,18)}, marker cells).
Click inactive marker -> armed mode (color_1 players, marker active color_11, A1-4 move it, blocked by maze/other markers/players); click active marker = no-op; click player -> block mode.
Hidden state: action counter a (every action incl. no-ops), bar w = 3(a+1)//7 drawn at (64-w,0) and (0,63); gated on continuity, fallback a=0 if no bar else largest a for that width.
Names = type_color_rank by (y,x), ranks from 2 in block mode (blocks keep block_left/right), from 0 in armed mode.
Unconfirmed: maze cells outside those inferred, marker-vs-player blocking, level end/reset triggers (step 75 reset unobserved).
